recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source fix is needed for FHIR-11344; future work should only revisit this area if Patient Care decides to remove the commented legacy plannedActivityDetail block or reintroduce inline CarePlan activity details.
issue_request: FHIR-11344 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 Patient Care request to allow CarePlan.activity.detail.performer to reference CareTeam and to revise CareTeam boundary text so CareTeam was not described as unable to act when used for care-plan responsibility.
initial_application: Historical commit df58ee3f55 explicitly cited #11344, added CareTeam to the old CarePlan.activity.detail.performer target list, and replaced the CareTeam boundary sentence that said "CareTeam isn't an actor" with wording about individual members or organized groups of individuals.
additional_context: CarePlan and CareTeam are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The old CarePlan.activity.detail element maps forward to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference, and FHIR-39101 later removed the active inline plannedActivityDetail model by commenting out that block. The commented legacy performer block still includes CareTeam. Current CareTeam boundaries no longer contain the rejected actor prohibition and were later clarified by FHIR-46553 to say Group resource.
reconciliation: No source change was made. There is no active CarePlan.activity.detail.performer or plannedActivityDetail.performer target list in the current build to modify, and the current CareTeam narrative already avoids the stale actor prohibition while preserving the approved organized-group concept.
